title.purpose: Snip name in the capture palette.

nativeConventions.units: Tk positive font sizes are points; geometry, padding and highlight thickness are pixels. Actual rendering depends on Windows/Tk scaling.
nativeConventions.buttonFocus: takefocus=True; highlightthickness=2; light-gold focus; primary buttons keep a light-gold edge.
nativeConventions.buttonRelief: flat, borderwidth=0; selected annotation tool uses sunken relief
nativeConventions.urlReturn: Entry and Capture submit; focused Cancel cancels. Escape cancels.
nativeConventions.editorNavigation: Both native scrollbars; canvasx/canvasy preserve drawing coordinates after scrolling. Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+S and Escape are bound.
nativeConventions.region: 35% background brightness, undimmed selection, 2px accent outline, crosshair; Escape and right-click cancel.
nativeConventions.previewPolicy: Native Tk components are documented as descriptions, not fabricated HTML/CSS replicas. No HTML/CSS detector or browser-rendered accessibility claim applies.
nativeConventions.tokenPolicy: Primitives live in DESIGN.md. No synthetic tonal ramps, motion tokens or breakpoints are asserted as implementation.
nativeConventions.accessibilityLimit: Focus and shortcuts are implemented. Region selection and drawing remain pointer operations. Screen-reader support and standards conformance have not been established.

evidence.checked: Existing captures document retained geometry and interactions. The current palette was checked against theme.py, annotate.py, region.py, url_prompt.py and the approved gold previews; this refresh is not a new finish-review disposition.

extensions.contrastException: White labels on solid gold retain the approved brand exception. This pairing does not establish ordinary small-text contrast compliance.
extensions.documentationEvidence: Refreshed against the implemented gold theme source and approved native gold previews. This is documentation of the approved palette and retained behavior, not accessibility certification.

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Native focusable Tk button for Cancel, palette actions, tools and Undo; flat relief and a 2px accent focus highlight.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Native gold Capture or Save button with a white label, darker-gold active fill and light-gold edge.

components.name: URL field
components.description: Native single-line entry with a visible focus highlight, insertion cursor, instructions and inline validation.

components.name: Selected annotation tool
components.description: Light-gray fill, dark text and sunken relief identify the current Arrow, Box, Blur or Redact tool.

components.name: Capture palette
components.description: Borderless pointer-positioned palette with full-width labeled actions, letter shortcuts, arrow-key traversal and focus-driven scrolling.

components.name: Annotation canvas
components.description: Image-preserving canvas with vertical and horizontal native scrollbars; coordinates account for scrolling.

components.name: Region selector
components.description: Dimmed screenshot overlay reveals a bright rectangular selection and live dimensions during pointer drag.

narrative.overview: Dark neutral surfaces, white text and SRC gold actions share the approved theme with Silent Type and Dictate. Segoe UI, labeled controls and visible focus retain the native Windows workflow.
keyCharacteristics: Gold primary actions and light-gold focus
Charcoal annotations; captured images retain their colors
dos: Do reuse the shared theme and button styles.
Do preserve labeled actions, visible focus and keyboard cancellation.
Do keep the image accessible through both scrollbars when the editor is narrowed.
Do retain the captured image's colors and distinguish Blur from Redact in text.
donts: Don't add decorative fonts, gradients or bespoke window chrome.
Don't let a dialog-wide Return handler override the focused Cancel button.
Don't describe native Tk behavior as HTML/CSS or claim untested accessibility compliance.
